chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man whom a creature harms while he is performing salat (prayer). He said:
"He may cast it away from himself if he wishes, or bury it in the pebbles."

key_terms.الدَّابَّةُ: a creature or crawling animal that causes harm
key_terms.الْحَصَى: the pebbles or small stones on the ground
key_terms.تُؤْذِيهِ: harms him or causes him injury or annoyance
key_terms.يُلْقِيهَا: he throws it away or casts it off

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if a harmful creature bothers him during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one performing salat (prayer) who is harmed by a creature during the prayer. It permits removing the harmful creature or burying it in the pebbles, showing allowance for limited action during salat (prayer) to prevent harm.
